strings.Reprendre la structure détectée dans les: Use the detected structure in the lyrics
strings.Mode automatique : applique les balises: Automatic mode: applies the checked tags and the structure, then starts the generation. With no lyrics to sing, the cover is generated as an instrumental.
strings.Mémoire vidéo dédiée occupée sur la cart: Dedicated video memory used on the card, all programs combined.
strings.Mémoire système utilisée par la carte qu:
System memory used by the card when its own memory is full: much slower,
it greatly slows down generation. Full dial = 2 GB.
strings.Avec une limite, le compteur montre la m: With a limit, the dial shows the average of the last 16 seconds: on a long song, the card alternates steps of several seconds at full power with pauses, so the limit applies on average.
strings.Utilisation du processeur, tous programm: Processor usage, all programs combined (as in Task Manager).
strings.Utilisation de la carte graphique : mote:
Graphics card usage: busiest engine (3D, compute, video…), all programs combined.
During a generation it should stay close to the maximum.
strings.Carte graphique non reconnue : recommand: Graphics card not recognized: no recommendations possible.
strings.Durée : jusqu'à 6 minutes sans débordeme: Duration: up to 6 minutes without overflow.
strings.Durée : jusqu'à 4 à 5 minutes sans débor: Duration: up to 4 to 5 minutes without overflow, if no other program is using the card.
strings.Durée : 3 minutes au plus ; au-delà, la: Duration: 3 minutes at most; beyond that the card's memory overflows and generation slows down a lot.
strings.Carte trop juste (moins de 8 Go) : 2 min: Card too small (under 8 GB): 2 minutes at most, overflow likely.
strings.Carte AMD : mode stable (FP32) conservé,: AMD card: stable mode (FP32) kept, required on RX 6000 cards.
strings.Carte Nvidia : installez le moteur CUDA: Nvidia card: install the CUDA engine (“outils\moteur\cuda” folder), often faster than Vulkan.
strings.Carte Intel ou inconnue : non testée, ga: Intel or unknown card: untested, keep stable mode.
strings.Mémoire vive : %.0f Go. 16 Go conseillés: RAM: %.0f GB. 16 GB recommended: when it overflows, the card uses system RAM.
strings.Les modèles sont sur un disque dur (%s): The models are on a hard disk (%s): each generation reloads 3 to 4 GB, about 30 s more. Put the models folder on an SSD.
strings.Modèles sur un SSD (%s) : chargement rap: Models on an SSD (%s): fast loading.
strings.Processeur de moins de 8 cœurs logiques: Processor with fewer than 8 logical cores: audio analysis and exports will be slower.
strings.%s · %.0f Go de mémoire vive · %s (%d cœ: %s · %.0f GB of RAM · %s (%d logical cores) · models disk: %s
strings.Réglages conseillés appliqués (modèle et: Recommended settings applied (default model and solver).
strings.(modèle %s non installé : seul le solveu: (model %s not installed: only the solver will change)
strings.L'IA locale est en train d'écrire : atte: The local AI is writing: wait until it finishes (or “Stop”) before generating.
strings.Cette génération demande environ %.1f Go: This generation needs about %.1f GB of video memory; %.1f GB are free. The rest will overflow into system memory and generation will be much slower (2 to 8 times).
strings.Fermez ceux dont vous n'avez pas besoin: Close the ones you don't need (browser, games, video software), then start the generation again.
strings.Le moteur est mis en pause par intervall:
The engine is paused for very short intervals to give the card a break (temperature, noise, other programs).
Example: limit at 90 → generation about 1.1 times longer. Approximate effect: trust the “GPU usage” gauge.
strings.Stable sur les cartes AMD et Intel, rapi: Stable on AMD and Intel cards, fast on Nvidia cards.
strings.Impose les calculs en précision complète: Forces full-precision (FP32) computation: required on AMD RDNA2 cards (RX 6000), worth trying if a song crackles or clips.
strings.Calculs en demi-précision : plus rapide,: Half-precision computation: faster, but may crackle on some AMD cards.
strings.Avec le moteur CUDA, ce réglage n'a pas: With the CUDA engine, this setting has no effect (it applies to the Vulkan engine).
strings.Moteur CUDA non installé : dossier « out: CUDA engine not installed: “outils\moteur\cuda” folder missing.
strings.Redémarrez l'application pour changer de: Restart the application to switch engines.
strings.Carte Nvidia : le moteur Vulkan fonction: Nvidia card: the Vulkan engine works. The CUDA engine, often faster, is installed by unzipping its archive into the application folder (“outils\moteur\cuda” folder).
strings.Version installée : %s · nouvelle versio:
Installed version: %s · new version: %s
Opens the latest version's page on GitHub (files to download).
strings.La commercialisation des morceaux, poche: Selling the tracks, covers and videos made with Studio Audio AI is subject to the licences of the models used. Refer to their licences:
strings.licence propre à chaque LoRA (voir sa pa: each LoRA has its own licence (see its page)
strings.Les textes complets sont sur la page de: The full texts are on each model's page (Hugging Face); those of the bundled programs are in the “LICENSES” folder.
strings.Recherche de mise à jour : pas encore de: Update check: no publishing site yet.
Some expected files cannot be found. Your settings, styles, LoRA list and each track's sheet are backed up every day in the program's “sauvegardes” folder.
strings.Formulaire vidé : vous pouvez coller un: Form cleared: you can paste a new track.

strings.Aucune parole dans la structure : %d bal: No lyrics in the structure: %d voice tag(s) removed from the style before generating.
strings.Morceau long : il faut au moins deux sec: Long track: you need at least two sections ([Verse], [Chorus]…) to cut it into two parts.
strings.%d versions de « %s » ajoutées à la file: %d versions of “%s” added to the queue, paused.
%d versions of “%s” added to the queue.
strings.Re-rendu de « %s » (même graine) ajouté: Re-render of “%s” (same seed) added to the queue.
strings.Re-rendu de « %s » (graine aléatoire) aj: Re-render of “%s” (random seed) added to the queue.
strings.Recomposition de « %s » ajoutée à la fil: Recomposition of “%s” added to the queue.
strings.Convertit le style et les paroles déjà c: Converts the style and lyrics already pasted (Suno format) into YuE2 format.
strings.%d ligne(s) non traduite(s) par le modèl: %d line(s) not translated by the local model: check the lyrics.
strings.Attention : YuE2 ne chante pas cette lan: Warning: YuE2 does not sing this language, the result will be uncertain.
strings.Sans Internet : seules les langues du mo: Without Internet: only the local model's languages are offered.
strings.Traduit les lignes chantées ; les balise:
Translates the sung lines; section tags ([Verse], [Chorus]…) and empty lines stay in place.
Over the Internet (Google Translate) when possible, otherwise with the local model.
strings.Le bouton « Traduire » du bloc Paroles t: The “Translate” button in the Lyrics block translates the sung lines into another language without touching the section tags. Over the Internet: Google Translate (free, over 100 languages; the lyrics are sent to Google). Offline: local Qwen2.5-3B model (about 2 GB, run on the processor to keep the card free, about twenty languages, 20 s to 1 min per song).
strings.Supprimer le modèle de traduction du dis: Delete the translation model from disk
strings.Modèle Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (Alibaba Clou: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model (Alibaba Cloud), Qwen Research license: personal, non-commercial use.
strings.Aucune balise rapide : tapez un terme da: No quick tags: type a term in the field to add it.
strings.La balise « %s » sera retirée des balise: The tag “%s” will be removed from the quick tags (the “Style to avoid” field is not changed).
strings.Balises proposées sous le champ « Style: Tags offered under the form's “Style to avoid” field. A term typed in that field is added here automatically; a tag's cross deletes it (after confirmation).
strings.Balises que le morceau doit éviter (inst:
Tags the song should avoid (instruments, voice effects…), separated by commas.
YuE2 was not trained for this: judge the effect by ear.
When this field is filled, composition is a little slower (about ×1.3) and needs about 2.7 GB more video memory.
strings.1,5 conseillé. Plus fort, le morceau s'é: 1.5 recommended. Higher moves the song further from the style to avoid, but may sound less natural.
strings.Tempo du morceau, de 60 à 260 BPM par pa: Track tempo, 60 to 260 BPM in steps of 1: adds the “BPM” tag to the style. Ctrl+click to type a number.
strings.Facultatif : réinterpréter un morceau ex: Optional: reinterpret an existing track in the chosen style.
strings.La partition (mélodie et accords) sera t: The score (melody and chords) will be transcribed, then replayed in the chosen style.
strings.La mélodie sera transcrite puis chantée: The melody will be transcribed, then sung in the chosen style: write the lyrics to sing.
strings.balises en anglais, séparées par des vir: tags in English, separated by commas
strings.Classique : onglets de balises.\nPastill:
Classic: tabs of tags.
Chips: your tags as removable chips, collapsible categories.
Builder: one list per category (genres, mood, voice, instruments, tempo).
strings.Langue placée en tête du style. YuE2 cha:
Language placed first in the style. YuE2 mostly sings in English:
the other languages (French, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean,
Mandarin, Cantonese) are possible but less natural.
strings.Ex. : French, grunge, 90s, melancholic,: E.g.: English, grunge, 90s, melancholic, 110 BPM, distorted guitar, raspy male vocal
strings.Ajoutez d'abord des sections ([Verse], [: First add sections ([Verse], [Chorus]…) in the field below.
strings.optionnelles, cumulables, une force par: optional, stackable, one strength per LoRA
strings.Aucune LoRA installée. Téléchargez-en da: No LoRA installed. Download some in Settings > LoRA: they change the style, voice or mood of the track.
strings.\nSans mot déclencheur : la LoRA est qua: No trigger word: the LoRA is still applied during generation.
strings.\nMot déclencheur « %s » : ajouté au sty: Trigger word “%s”: added to the style when the LoRA is ticked.
strings.%d LoRA active(s). Chacune est fusionnée: %d LoRA active. Each one is merged into the model on loading: expect 10 to 30 s more per track, with no slowdown afterwards.
No LoRA used for this track.
strings.Ajoute à la file sans lancer : vous le l: Adds to the queue without starting: you will start it when the graphics card is free.
strings.Estimée d'après les paroles : le modèle: Estimated from the lyrics: the model finishes on its own.
strings.Plafond en secondes : atteint, il déclen: Ceiling in seconds: when reached, it triggers a fade-out.
strings.Le modèle compose au plus 6 minutes d'un: The model composes at most 6 minutes at once. The lyrics are cut in two near the middle: part 1 is generated, then part 2 continues it from its last 25 seconds, and both are joined with a crossfade (up to about 11 minutes). The result is in part 2; part 1 stays in the library. Check the joins by ear.
strings.Si le morceau atteint le plafond de duré:
If the track reaches the duration ceiling without concluding (as with instrumentals), the fade-out
lasts as long as the last section of the structure (outro: 20 s in instrumental) and follows a soft curve,
instead of the short fade of the general setting (%d s).
strings.Partition reconnue : choisissez vos paro: Score recognised: choose your lyrics and style in “New track”, edit the score if needed, then generate.
strings.Partition prête : vérifiez-la, retouchez: Score ready: check it, edit it if needed, then generate the track.
strings.Ce fichier ne ressemble pas à une partit: This file does not look like an ABC score (no “K:” line).
strings.Le modèle écrit d'abord la partition du: The model first writes the track's score (key, tempo, chords, melody), then composes the sound following it. Here you can prepare that score on its own (≈ 1 min), check it, transpose it or change its tempo, then generate the track with it. Title, style and lyrics come from the “New track” tab.
strings.Une reprise a déjà sa partition (celle d: A cover already has its score (that of the original file).
strings.Renseignez d'abord le titre, le style et: First fill in the title, style and lyrics in “New track”.
strings.Indisponible pendant une génération ou u: Unavailable during a generation or a local AI request.
strings.Le modèle écrit la partition seule, sans: The model writes the score alone, without the sound (≈ 1 min). LoRA are only used to generate the track.
strings.Ou partir d'un morceau existant :: Or start from an existing track:
strings.Reconnaître la partition d'un fichier au: Recognise the score of an audio file…
strings.Modèles de transcription absents (SheetS: Transcription models missing (SheetSage2 and MERT in modeles\musique).
strings.SheetSage2 écoute le morceau et écrit sa: SheetSage2 listens to the track and writes its score (melody, plus chords if “Full” is chosen), ≈ 1 min for 3 min of music. You edit it, then generate with your own lyrics and style: like a cover, but the score is visible and editable.
strings.Ouvre l'Atelier partition vide : « Impor: Opens an empty Score workshop: “Import…” reads a MusicXML, MIDI or ABC file, shows it as notes, then “Use in the Studio” places it here.
strings.Ouvre l'Atelier partition : la partition: Opens the Score workshop: the score as notes, to listen to, print or save as PDF.
strings.Modifier le texte de la partition (ABC,: Edit the score text (ABC, for experts)
strings.« Nouveau morceau » est en mode Reprise: “New track” is in Cover mode: switch back to Song or Instrumental mode to create a track with this score.
strings.Pour générer, renseignez dans « Nouveau: To generate, fill in under “New track”: %s.
strings.Le morceau suit la partition donnée (ton: The track follows the given score (key, tempo, chords, melody); style, lyrics, LoRA and settings are those of “New track”.

strings.Efface influence, thème, ambiance, titre: Clears influence, theme, mood, title, wishes, band, album title and styles to avoid.

strings.L'IA conçoit l'album (groupe, titre, mor: The AI designs the album (band, title, tracks), then writes each track; the model is loaded only once. The tracks are added to the queue, paused, with the settings and LoRAs of “New track”.
strings.Chansons et instrumentaux dans le même a: Songs and instrumentals in the same album.
strings.facultatif : sinon l'IA le choisit: optional: otherwise the AI chooses it
strings.facultatif : sinon l'IA l'invente: optional: otherwise the AI invents it

strings.Groupe existant : son son est repris, et: Existing band: its sound is kept, and its %d titles and %d album(s) will not be reused.

strings.Version %s de llama.cpp (projet libre, l: llama.cpp version %s (open-source project, MIT licence) with Vulkan: the local AI writes 5 to 10 times faster on the graphics card and can use bigger models. Installed in the ia\llama folder.
strings.L'IA locale tourne sur ce PC, gratuiteme: The local AI runs on this PC, free and offline, but only when idle (no song being generated). A local server (Ollama, LM Studio…) works the same way. An online service writes better and faster, with your API key (pay per use, a few cents at most per song).
strings.Mots que l'IA ne doit employer ni dans l: Words the AI must use neither in titles nor in lyrics, separated by commas. If a track still contains some, the Studio asks once more.

strings.Extensions qui orientent le style, la vo: Extensions that steer the style, voice or mood of a track. The download goes straight into the application folder; the LoRA is then ticked in the form (several at once are possible). Each LoRA has its own license (most often non-commercial use).
strings.Ouvrir la page de la LoRA (auteur, licen: Open the LoRA page (author, license, examples)
strings.Une nouvelle version de cette LoRA est d: A new version of this LoRA is available: click to download it and replace the files.
strings.Supprimer les fichiers de cette LoRA du: Delete this LoRA's files from the disk
strings.LoRA personnelles : créées avec la Forge: Personal LoRAs: created with the Forge or placed by hand in modeles\lora. Hover over a name to see its description. A .json file with the same name, placed next to it, can provide the name, description and trigger word.
strings.\nMot « %s » de la fiche ignoré : la LoR: Word “%s” from the sheet ignored: the LoRA learned “%s” (retrain it to change the word).
strings.Supprimer ce fichier du disque: Delete this file from the disk
strings.Une LoRA déposée à la main est reconnue: A LoRA dropped in by hand is recognized automatically.
strings.Whisper (OpenAI, licence MIT, moteur whi: Whisper (OpenAI, MIT licence, whisper.cpp engine) writes out the lyrics of a sung audio file and detects its language. Quantized “medium” model (about 540 MB), run by the graphics card: about 35 seconds for a 5-minute track. The transcription is part of the analysis of a cover file; on music it is not perfect, so proofread the lyrics before generating.
strings.Nouvelle version disponible (%s, install: New version available (%s, installed: %s): click to download it and replace the file.
strings.Supprimer le modèle de transcription du: Delete the transcription model from the disk
strings.Vérifier la langue des morceaux: Check the language of the tracks
strings.Whisper écoute trois extraits de chaque: Whisper listens to three excerpts of each track not yet checked (%d): it corrects the lyrics language of sung tracks if it is clearly different, and flags tracks marked instrumental where it hears lyrics. Once per track.
strings.Quand vous choisissez un fichier audio p: When you choose an audio file for a cover, this tagging model (Discogs-EffNet and its classifiers, Essentia / Music Technology Group, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence, non-commercial use) detects genre, mood, instruments and voice type; the score (transcription engine) gives tempo, key, vocal range and structure. Together they suggest style tags and the lyrics structure.
strings.%d fichier(s) du modèle ont une nouvelle: %d file(s) of the model have a new version: click to download them.
strings.Supprimer le modèle d'analyse du disque: Delete the analysis model from the disk
strings.Analyser automatiquement le fichier choi: Automatically analyze the file chosen for a cover
strings.Chercher les paroles sur Internet pour c: Search the web for lyrics to correct the transcription
strings.Envoie le groupe et le titre du morceau: Sends the track's artist and title (file tags or file name) to lrclib.net, a free and open lyrics database. Without a connection, the Whisper transcription is kept.
strings.Chaque langue est un fichier du dossier: Each language is a file in the “langues” folder: to fix a translation or add one, edit or copy one of these files (see _modele.json). A language you add appears here at the next start.
strings.Le thème par défaut suit le mode clair o: The default theme follows the light or dark mode of Windows; the other themes are fixed. The change is immediate.
strings.Application réduite : jauges et compteur: Minimized app: gauges and counters next to the clock
strings.Quand la fenêtre est réduite, deux icône: When the window is minimized, two icons appear near the clock: three bars (CPU, GPU, GPU memory) and two numbers (songs waiting in purple, finished in green). Hover for exact values. On Windows 11, pin them via Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Other system tray icons if they stay hidden in the ^ menu.
strings.Suspendre la file de génération quand un: Suspend the generation queue when a game is launched
strings.La génération en cours est arrêtée (elle: The running generation is stopped (it will restart from the beginning) and the queue resumes 10 seconds after the game is closed. Full-screen games are detected automatically; list below any other programs to watch (file names separated by commas).
strings.● Aucun jeu détecté — la file peut tourn: ● No game detected — the queue can run
strings.Modèle par défaut au démarrage. Aux essa: Default model at startup. In tests, the three quantizations run just as fast; Q6_K and Q5_K_M only save 0.3 to 0.4 GB of video memory at peak. The quick choice in the top bar applies to the next tracks; each track remembers the model that produced it.
strings.Ouvre le téléchargement dans le navigate:
Opens the download in the browser (Hugging Face).
Then put the file in:
%s
strings.Supprimer ce modèle du disque: Delete this model from the disk
strings.La liste se met à jour à chaque ouvertur: The list is refreshed each time Settings is opened.
strings.Longueur du fondu appliqué quand un morc: Length of the fade applied when a track reaches the duration ceiling without concluding (instrumentals, fixed duration). In the form, “Fade out on the structure” replaces this setting with the length of the last section, with a softer curve.
strings.Solveur par défaut au démarrage : méthod: Default solver at startup: calculation method and number of steps of the audio phase, which dominates the generation time. The fewer network evaluations, the faster. The name gives the method then the number of steps (AB3 24 = Adams-Bashforth order 3, 24 steps; MP 32 = midpoint, 32 steps, the reference). The quick choice in the top bar applies to the next tracks; each track remembers its solver.

strings.Supprime tous les morceaux générés (audi: Deletes all generated tracks (audio, sheets, logs). They are sent to the Windows recycle bin: you can restore them from there. Album images and videos are not touched.
strings.Le fichier « %s » sera supprimé définiti: The file “%s” will be permanently deleted from the disk. You will be able to download it again; tracks already generated are not affected.

strings.Les fichiers du modèle d'analyse audio s: The audio analysis model files will be permanently deleted from the disk. You can download them again; songs already generated are not affected.
strings.Le fichier du modèle de transcription de: The lyrics transcription model file will be permanently deleted from the disk. You can download it again; songs already generated are not affected.
strings.Le modèle de traduction local sera suppr: The local translation model will be permanently deleted from disk. You can download it again; translation over the Internet remains available.
strings.La LoRA « %s » sera supprimée définitive: The LoRA “%s” will be permanently deleted from the disk. You will be able to download it again (if it is in the catalog); tracks already generated are not affected.
strings.Les %d morceaux de la bibliothèque seron: The %d tracks of the library will be sent to the Windows recycle bin. You can restore them from there as long as the bin is not emptied.

%d track(s) sent to the recycle bin.
